text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the removal of an on-street accessible loading zone operating from 6:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of Wallace Avenue, between a point 51 metres west of Lansdowne Avenue and a point 5.5 metres further west.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing on-street accessible loading zone operating from 6:00 a.m. to 3:30 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of Wallace Avenue, between a point 51 metres west of Lansdowne Avenue and a point 5.5 metres further west.
